summary: Learn Primavera P6 scheduling, baselines, and critical path control. Build practical construction control skills in 5 days.
lede: Construction planning and scheduling training helps construction professionals build and control project programmes in Primavera P6. You’ll practise structuring work with WBS hierarchies, activity relationships and calendars, then assess critical paths, compare progress with a baseline, and create status or recovery reports to support project decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, build, review, or control construction schedules in Primavera P6.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of construction project delivery, project controls, and basic scheduling concepts; prior exposure to Primavera P6 is helpful but not mandatory. You should be comfortable reading construction drawings, activity lists, and progress updates, and you should bring a laptop for hands-on Primavera P6 exercises. This is an advanced course, so we will work at implementation level for scheduling workflows, baseline control, and reporting, while delay-analysis concepts are addressed at operational level. No coding is required.
